records.description_rewritten: Bürgerpark Bremen is a privately managed public park held by the Bürgerparkverein, with an old cruising-directory area near Hollerallee and Parkhotel. Most recent forum posts found are from June 2025 and concern meeting arrangements, not observed activity. Crucially the 2025 park rules say staying in the park after 22:30 is forbidden except visiting venues, residents/service buildings or passing through. The source's older night-cruising descriptions should not be recommended without reflecting this restriction.

Do not provide routes through fences.

records.description_rewritten: Uni-See (Stadtwaldsee) in Bremen is a recreation lake with a FKK section and neighbouring nature reserve. Three 2026 forum posts document current conditions: September first-person onsite presence and an assertion meetings remain possible, March reports of scrub removed and more visibility and patrols, and June questions about new fencing of former FKK woods. A city-related October 2026 shoreline stabilisation programme creates new fenced edges and warns of life-threatening unstable sand during winter; plans begin in November. These are meaningful recent activity/access signals, but no verified current sexual encounter is documented.

additional_sources.note: March, June, September 2026 firsthand presence/access reports.
21 Oct 2026 reported shoreline works, fencing and winter quicksand danger.

records.access_information: FKK beach and lake public recreation where posted; restricted Uni-Wildnis conservation area and fenced wetland; autumn 2026 shoreline construction plus dangerous fresh sand. Do not cross fences or enter unstable banks.
